usedFor: GiftUp takes gift card orders, and Pipedrive gains a person when “New Order” runs “Create Person”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order” in GiftUp, then “Create Person” in Pipedrive
bestTemplate.why: Every gift card buyer is added to Pipedrive, so sales can follow up with people who already paid.

watchOut: “Create Person” runs on each “New Order”, so a repeat buyer can show up in Pipedrive more than once.
